# Core Rule 2 ## Respect each other.
- [color=red][bold]In and out of character discrimination based upon race, sexuality, and gender is strictly prohibited. If in-character actions are becoming out of character insults, it will be considered a rule break.[/bold][/color]
- [color=green][bold]In character discrimination based upon species, disabilities, injuries, and religion is allowed, you can use discrimination to escalate if it's used against you, but it should not be the sole reason you attack someone.[/bold][/color]
- [color=yellow][bold]Speciesm is allowed, slurs regarding species cannot be parodies of real life slurs like "ligger". Speciest slurs, if used against you, can be used to escalate into combat but should not be the only reason to attack someone.[/bold][/color]
- [italics][color=green]If you believe a word will go too far, utilize admin help (F1) to ask for clarification. No response means you cannot say it.[/italics][/color]
